alternatives.broad_nasdaq: rejected: same coverage but no ECON_STOCKMARKET relevance filter

manual_relevance_review.method: Thirty dates per non-empty scope, distributed across the full period, with up to three example URLs per date.
manual_relevance_review.finding: The selected scope contains broad market and technology-market reporting together with some company-specific stories. It is more relevant than broad_nasdaq but is not an index-exclusive news corpus.
manual_relevance_review.retrieval_limitation: Many historical URLs are unavailable or blocked; classification therefore also uses the URL title path retained by GDELT.

interpretation_constraint: Use the series as a Nasdaq/technology-market news-tone proxy. Do not describe it as sentiment measured exclusively from NASDAQ-100 articles.
missing_value_decision: Exclude and report 2017-08-29; do not forward-fill or impute a neutral tone.
